name: horror
premise: The world is not safe and was never safe; the protagonist has only just noticed.
obligatory_beats: an early wrongness the protagonist explains away with a reasonable theory
a moment where retreat was still possible and is declined
the thing is understood too late to act on the understanding
pacing_curve: Long, quiet opening. Withhold. Compress hard in the last third — sentences shorten as control is lost.
sensory_palette: sound in rooms that should be empty
the specific quality of light in a place at the wrong hour
cold that arrives before its cause
pov_distance: Close third, slightly unreliable. The reader should notice what the narrator is refusing to notice.
dialogue_register: Clipped and evasive. People talk around the thing rather than naming it. Silences carry weight.
taboo_moves: explaining the mechanism — how it works is never as frightening as that it works
a comic beat that releases accumulated tension
reassurance from a character who turns out to be right
